readerCopy.body: Something you normally censor may come out more easily in art, writing, fantasy, humor, or a conversation that feels unusually unguarded. Neptune trine Lilith can loosen the rules around what is acceptable to imagine or admit without requiring you to turn every private thought into a public declaration. Pay attention to what keeps returning when you stop correcting it. Inspiration can reveal a desire before you have decided what to do about it.
